item.title: From Question to Table Name: Trying a Small Decision Model Where Everyone Reaches for an LLM
item.description: We needed to map a free-form user question to one of about 1,000 database table names, fast and on our own hardware. We tried Laya, the open-source “System-1 decision model,” end to end: zero-shot, with hybrid retrieval, and finally fine-tuned on synthetic data. Here is what worked, what quietly failed, and what we would do differently. The problem Our data platform exposes roughly 1,000 logical tables. Users ask questions like “what were the total daily sales per store in January, day by day?
